title: RemoteEvent.OnClientEvent
summary: Client-side event that fires when the server sends a message via FireClient/FireAllClients. Receives exactly the server's arguments — no player parameter on this side.

parameters.name: ...args
parameters.description: The server's FireClient/FireAllClients arguments, verbatim. No injected player — unlike OnServerEvent.

details.heading: Where it works
details.body: LocalScripts only. On the server, sending-side is FireClient/FireAllClients and receiving-side is OnServerEvent.

explanation.whatItIs: The client's mailbox for server messages: rounds starting, data updates, 'play this sound now'.
explanation.whyItExists: The server decides; clients display and react. OnClientEvent is how decisions arrive.
whenToUse: Updating HUDs from server state (coins, timers)
Triggering local effects (sounds, camera work) on command
whenNotToUse: As your only sync mechanism for fast-changing state — consider attributes/replication or unreliable remotes
tips: Connect early in client boot (after WaitForChild on the remote)
Include a 'kind' string first argument to multiplex one remote
Arguments are serialized copies — mutating received tables doesn't touch the server
commonMistakes: Expecting a player parameter like OnServerEvent — there isn't one
Connecting after the server already fired — missed messages; connect before the game state flows
Heavy work inside the handler blocking other messages

examples.title: Multiplexed client handler
examples.code:
-- LocalScript
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("GameState")

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, value)
    if kind == "Coins" then
        script.Parent.HUD.Coins.Text = `💰 {value}`
    elseif kind == "Phase" then
        print("Phase changed to:", value)
    elseif kind == "PlaySound" then
        -- play sound id in value…
    end
end)
